tokens.name: bg-base
tokens.usage: App ground behind every surface. DSH --dsw-alias-bg-base.

tokens.name: bg-layer-1
tokens.usage: First raised surface; ground of text-field wrappers and empty states. --dsw-alias-bg-layer-1.

tokens.name: bg-layer-2
tokens.usage: Settings panel and settings-card fill (--dsw-alias-settings-card-fill maps here).

tokens.name: bg-layer-3
tokens.usage: Highest raised layer; dsh-market SettingsCard fallback fill.

tokens.name: bg-module-platform
tokens.usage: Fill of buttons, selector pills, menu triggers, storage metrics and progress tracks inside a card.

tokens.name: bg-overlay
tokens.usage: Overlay and popover scrim layer.

tokens.name: menu-surface
tokens.usage: Translucent fill of the @ menu and dropdown menus (--dsw-specific-menu).

tokens.name: label-primary
tokens.usage: Titles, body copy, menu item names and primary-button fill. On bg-layer-1/2, bg-module-platform and menu-surface: 19:1 light, 13:1 dark.

tokens.name: label-secondary
tokens.usage: Secondary text and @ menu source icons. On bg-layer-2: 5.8:1 light, 9.3:1 dark.

tokens.name: label-tertiary
tokens.usage: Row descriptions, menu item descriptions, section titles, placeholders, chevrons. Source value kept: 3.7:1 on white in light (below 4.5:1 for 12px text), 6.5:1 on bg-layer-2 in dark.

tokens.name: label-caption
tokens.usage: Weakest metadata such as the Tab keycap hint in the menu. Decorative only: 2.1:1 on white, so never the only carrier of meaning.

tokens.name: label-dimmed
tokens.usage: Hover and open stroke of a collapsible card.

tokens.name: label-primary-foreground
tokens.usage: Text on a label-primary fill: primary buttons, badges, notices, the on-state switch thumb.

tokens.name: menu-icon
tokens.usage: Official menu glyphs: drill chevron and breadcrumb separators.

tokens.name: border-l1
tokens.usage: Menu frame stroke and breadcrumb divider.

tokens.name: border-l2
tokens.usage: 0.5px hairline between preference rows, list rows and card foot dividers.

tokens.name: border-l3
tokens.usage: Switch track when off; text-field stroke while focused.

tokens.name: border-l4
tokens.usage: 0.5px stroke of text fields and settings cards (--dsw-alias-settings-card-stroke).

tokens.name: interactive-bg-hover
tokens.usage: The one hover and keyboard highlight for buttons, menu items and drag handles.

tokens.name: interactive-bg-active
tokens.usage: Pressed state of a highlighted control.

tokens.name: brand-primary
tokens.usage: DSH brand-primary is monochrome: the on-state switch track. Not blue.

tokens.name: switch-thumb
tokens.usage: Switch thumb in the off state.

tokens.name: state-business-primary
tokens.usage: The one accent: links, keyboard focus ring, reference chips in the composer. Never a large fill. Source value kept: 4.2:1 on white (meets 3:1 for the focus ring, below 4.5:1 for small link text), 6.0:1 on bg-layer-2 dark.

tokens.name: state-error-primary
tokens.usage: Error text and the 28% hairline above a source-card error; invalid chips.

tokens.name: state-success-primary
tokens.usage: Success marks. Always paired with a word or icon (2.3:1 on white).

tokens.name: state-warn-primary
tokens.usage: Warning marks. Always paired with a word or icon (2.1:1 on white).

families.sans: -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Hiragino Sans GB", "Microsoft YaHei", "Helvetica Neue", Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

families.brand: Montserrat, -apple-system, BlinkMacSystemFont, "Segoe UI", "PingFang SC", "Microsoft YaHei", sans-serif

styles.name: metric
styles.usage: Item count on a source card.

styles.name: body-lg
styles.sample: 长文本与主要内容正文

styles.name: body
styles.usage: Row titles, card titles, buttons, selectors, inputs. The settings default.

styles.name: compact
styles.sample: 在 @ 菜单中显示可调用的命令。

styles.name: caption
styles.sample: 凭据已保存到系统密钥库
styles.usage: Row descriptions, card notes, progress labels, errors. Smallest settings text.

styles.name: menu-meta
styles.usage: Right-aligned item description, command alias, agent preview text.

styles.name: menu-section
styles.usage: Section title above a source group, in label-tertiary.

styles.name: code
styles.usage: Paths, entry ids and detected Agent directories.

tokens.name: space-1
tokens.usage: Title-to-description gap, icon-to-text in chips, menu frame padding.

tokens.name: space-2
tokens.usage: Inline controls, button groups, icon-to-label.

tokens.name: space-3
tokens.usage: Menu item padding, card inner gaps, list row vertical padding.

tokens.name: space-3.5
tokens.usage: Horizontal padding of buttons, selectors and text fields.

tokens.name: space-4
tokens.usage: Card padding, gap between project cards, preference row padding.

tokens.name: space-5
tokens.usage: Header breathing room.

tokens.name: space-6
tokens.usage: Settings top padding; column gap between row text and its control.

tokens.name: space-8
tokens.usage: Large block separation.

tokens.name: space-12
tokens.usage: Generous grouping; reserved right padding of preference row text.

tokens.name: radius-xs
tokens.usage: Keycap hints, drill chevron, skeleton bars.

tokens.name: radius-sm
tokens.usage: Breadcrumbs, agent preview message bubbles.

tokens.name: radius-md
tokens.usage: Buttons, selectors, inputs, menu items, nav cells.

tokens.name: radius-lg
tokens.usage: The @ menu surface.

tokens.name: radius-xl
tokens.usage: Every surface that reads as a card: project cards, source cards, picker list.

tokens.name: radius-panel
tokens.usage: Settings modal panel.

tokens.name: radius-pill
tokens.usage: Switch tracks only.

tokens.name: radius-round
tokens.usage: Switch thumbs, status dots, 32px health markers.

size.note: Fixed component dimensions. A longer label truncates or wraps; it never changes these.

tokens.name: control-height
tokens.usage: Buttons, selectors, text fields, drag handles.

tokens.name: control-width
tokens.usage: Right-hand selector or field of a preference row.

tokens.name: menu-item-height
tokens.usage: Minimum height of an @ menu or dropdown item.

tokens.name: row-min-height
tokens.usage: Preference row inside a settings card.

tokens.name: card-head-min-height
tokens.usage: Collapsible project-card header.

tokens.name: icon
tokens.usage: Menu source icons and settings glyphs.

tokens.name: icon-command
tokens.usage: Command glyph in the @ menu.

tokens.name: source-mark
tokens.usage: Provider mark on a source card.

tokens.usage: Switch track width; height 20px, thumb 16px.

tokens.name: close-button

tokens.name: hairline
